notes.title: A New Game Page, A New Trailer, and Demo Update!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! I'm so excited to bring you several big updates this month![/p][p][/p][h3]A New Game Page[/h3][p]First, I'm thrilled to reveal the brand new cover art! Special thanks to everyone on social media who helped me choose their favorite capsule art.[/p][p]New Capsule art concept:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/4a9d0ed8c6c2344edff6da87e43288578723fb37.png"][/img][/p][p]Your feedback was important to me, and the result is a capsule art that better captures the game's mood.[/p][p]Final new capsule art:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/973365a912bacafbc19066b7b382771c1d4f4306.png"][/img][/p][p]Along with the cover, I've given the entire game page a [b]complete[/b] makeover, with updated descriptions and fresh character profile pictures. [/p][p][/p][h3]Old Profile art:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/d13b9325f87ff1011e2de1ebeb4f5dc4dc77f7d9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/556ecbcfecfcc56bb4903636e627e8f166ab85b1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New profile art[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/ec63bee8baee6506a8e74c448372355c15784a64.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/520aacde041bf85c299d9fabf648119fb4dda663.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can see all the updated changes here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3552020/Fates_Masquerade_Otome_Visual_Novel/"]Fate's Masquerade Steam Page[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]A New Trailer[/h3][p]As I work on this game, I've also been leveling up my artistic skills. I’ve learnt to illustrate better lighting, add more details to the backgrounds, and continually refine the character art. These updated arts in the game inspired me to create a completely new trailer that better reflects the game's world and atmosphere. You can see the latest trailer here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3552020/Fates_Masquerade_Otome_Visual_Novel/"]trailer[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Demo Update[/h3][p]But the updates don't stop there! The common route has gotten a [b]major[/b] rewrite, and an updated demo is in progress! The new demo will feature changes to character stories, more meaningful choices, and, most exciting of all, more interactions with the princes!!![/p][p][/p][h3]Thanks to My Supporters![/h3][p]I've received so much support since the inception of the game, and I'm incredibly grateful to everyone who has encouraged me on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/smallserenity.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], [url="https://x.com/SmallSerenitySt"]X[/url], [url="https://smallserenitystudio.itch.io/fates-masquerade"]Itch.io[/url], and especially those who have joined my little [url="https://discord.com/invite/awHEdUHzNF"]Discord[/url] channel. [/p][p][/p][p]My game is made for wonderful people like you, so thank you all so much for your support![/p]

notes.title: A Royal Glow-Up & A Prince's Wardrobe
notes.content:
[p]Welcome to the first official devlog for Fates Masquerade! I'm excited to start sharing regular, in-depth updates on my progress with you. I've been working incredibly hard, and I can't wait to show you what I've been up to![/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Road to Maximilian's Finale[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The biggest news this month is that a major milestone has been reached on Crown Prince Maximilian's route: It's now 75% complete![/p][p][/p][p]I am officially entering the final and most dramatic act of this story. It has been quite the journey, both in terms of writing and in terms of my growth as an artist and developer. I've evolved my approach to directing scenes to be more engaging and cinematic, and I've completely overhauled my sprite creation process to make the characters more detailed.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h2][b]Maximilian's New Look[/b][/h2][p]A significant portion of my focus has been on improving the quality of the artwork for the final game. The result of this overhaul is a sprite with a resolution that is 300% higher, as well as more detailed hair, facial features, and a completely redrawn outfit.[/p][p][/p][h3]Maximilian draft:[/h3][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/0e9b787c38ccd09fdefa1eb021d621ec0f387221.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]Maximilian update:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/801d4a7069f8b87f293b2097d5edcbfade745123.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Lucian's Polished Look[/b][/h2][p]Prince Lucian received similar treatment! I increased the resolution of his sprite, refined his hairstyle, and gave him a new, more princely outfit that better suits his enigmatic character. However, I expect him to continue evolving as I work on his storyline.[/p][p][/p][h3]Lucian draft:[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/ca107ca48b23d1f9f21fbb745bcbb47e3bd72359.png"][/img][/p][h3]Lucian update:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/c6cc7d747298d8a51df1d7af2e13ea773bf6b8b5.gif"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]What do you all think of the new looks?[/b][/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]A Wardrobe Fit for a Prince[/b][/h2][p]Of course, a prince can't deal with political intrigue in just one outfit. I had a blast designing a full wardrobe for Maximilian. Each design reflects his story, status, and state of mind. Here's a spoiler-free selection of a few pieces![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/22fca3689794c95d40ac40e8d353ae8ecdb3e154.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/bb32c19e28035032cdfe273c8c7bc2581e1b896e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526912/58ddaa1d36e597f37e12e64963db2bb51b1fd149.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h2][b]A Look Ahead: High Stakes & High Emotion[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]For writers, the final 25% of a story is often the most exhilarating to create. All the threads begin to weave together, long-buried secrets come to light, long-awaited confessions are made, and pivotal moments unfold. Some scenes are achingly bittersweet, while others are warm and tender. All of them carry the weight of every choice you've made so far in the story. [/p][p][/p][p]I'm pouring all my energy into ensuring that the reward for your previous choices feels impactful and satisfying. I can't wait for you to experience it! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for keeping me going![/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h3]Which of the outfits shown are you most excited to see in the game? Let me know in the comments below. Feel free to join the conversation on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/awHEdUHzNF"]Discord server[/url].[/h3]

notes.title: Watch's Fate's Masquerade Demo Stream by Blerdy Otome
notes.content:
We’re very excited to share that Blerdy Otome has streamed and uploaded a demo playthrough of Fate’s Masquerade!

We were honestly laughing the entire time during the stream. It was so much fun watching her react to the characters, dialogue, and choices. No filter, no holding back. Just pure, unadulterated reactions that had us absolutely keeled over with laughter!

A huge thanks to Blerdy Otome for taking the time to play. Her end analysis of the characters and the story is spot on!

Check out the stream here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GENUm61ktXk
If you love otome games, big laughs, and thoughtful commentary, her channel is a must-watch!
